A '''chain-sickle''' was a type of [[Flail|weapon]] used by various cultures and groups, including the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] and [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Description==
[[File:NightsisterFlail-Monster.png|thumb|left|200px|The blades of a Nightsister chain-sickle]]
A sinister looking weapon, the chain-sickle consisted of a cylindrical handle from which extended a flexible cord that ended with a razor-sharp, bladed bludgeon. About one quarter of the way up the the cord from the main handle, was a second grip for another hand, which allowed the wielder to swing the chain-sickle with accuracy and force. The last half of the cords leading to the bludgeon was studded with small spikes which could still inflict damage even if a target evaded the primary blades. The most lethal section of the weapon was a large scythe-shaped blade covering half of the bludgeon with two smaller blades protruding opposite the main blade.

==History==
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thame Cerulian]] once fought against three chain-sickle-wielding [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Filve]], and barely made it out of the encounter alive.

[[File:Ventress_Chain_Sickle.png|thumb|left|250px|Asajj Ventress wielding a chain-sickle during the Selection]]
After [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had betrayed her, and presumed her dead, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] returned to her Nightsister clan on Dathomir to seek a means of exacting vengeance against her former master. She traveled to the [[Nightbrother village/Legends|Nightbrother village]] to find a suitable warrior to be given to Dooku as her replacement, who would then turn on the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and kill him. She chose a group of [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] to be [[Selection/Legends|tested]]. The one who survived the trials would become her champion. During the [[Test of Night]], Ventress wielded a chain-sickle while using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to conceal herself from sight and move at accelerated speeds. Using the weapon, she dispatched two Nightbrothers in a matter of moments.

A short time later, the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sent [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to Dathomir to search out information on the [[Savage Opress/Legends|mysterious assassin]] who had killed two Jedi on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. As the two Jedi entered the Nightbrother village, they were beset by the men of the village. One of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]] was wielding a chain-sickle with which he very nearly took Skywalker's head off.

==Behind the scenes==
One such weapon was seen in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], hanging on a wall in [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|Ben Kenobi's hut]]. In the reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'', this chain-sickle was described as one of several weapons taken from the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]].
